column1: # Expected fixture count per canonical suite. Format: <runner basename><TAB><count>
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (MOGO-021 §18.12). run_all.sh failed a suite only on ZERO fixtures, a
# RUNNER ERROR line, a nonzero exit, or a FAIL line -- it never checked that a suite produced the
# number of fixtures it is supposed to. A suite whose section throws part-way collapses several
# fixtures into one caught error and quietly runs SHORT: during verification the display suite
# silently ran 36 instead of 39 and nothing in the gate objected to the missing three.
# regression-baseline.json already had a `fixtureCounts` map, but it was stale (34 suites, 984
# total, no v1238 entries) and regression-baseline-tools.py only ever WROTE it, never compared --
# inert metadata that read like a pinned assertion. This file is the assertion.
# A suite that runs SHORT now fails the gate. Adding fixtures requires updating the count here,
# deliberately: that is the same friction the protected-function baseline imposes, for the same
